Tiszadob Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Petőfi utca 36, Hungary

Not demolished. Established in 1821, this cemetery served a community some of whose members left in 1845 to help found the Orthodox congregation of nearby Balmazújváros. On the night of April 14, 1944, following Germany's occupation of Hungary, police forced Tiszadob's Jews into the synagogue and from there to the Nyíregyháza Ghetto; weeks later, they were marched 8 kilometers in pouring rain to the railway station and deported to Auschwitz. Only 8 survivors returned after the war, and the community was never re-established; a memorial to the victims was erected in 1947.
